cards.subject: The moonwell
lines: The Moonshrine Sanctum still holds the temple's moonwell. In year twenty-five the corruption of an Old God seeped up from beneath the earth and tainted it.
This is not a ruin that monsters moved into. It is a holy well that went bad from below, and Aku'mai came up out of the result.

cards.subject: The door is under the sea
lines: You swim down to a submerged cave mouth to get in.
It is one of very few dungeons in the game whose entrance is below the water, and that is the whole point.
You are entering a building the ocean took.

cards.subject: Ghamoo-ra
lines: An ancient, harmless creature in the Pool of Ask'ar, until the Twilight's Hammer captured it and tortured it into madness.
Everybody kills it for the quest.
Nobody is ever told it was one of the cult's victims, the same as the sacrifices.

cards.subject: Gelihast
lines: A deep sea murloc who answered the Old Gods' call, came up into the ruins, and violently carved out a shrine of his own.
It is named after him.
No other murloc anywhere has a place of worship with his name on it.

cards.subject: Lady Sarevess
lines: The cult gave the naga sorceress her own cove and a steady supply of fresh sacrifices.
In exchange she works magic to keep the hydra off them.
They are paying a naga in lives for insurance against the god they are themselves feeding.

cards.subject: Old Serra'kis
lines: You reach him by diving beside the Moonshrine Sanctum and swimming under the ruins. His cave has no air pocket.
Your breath bar is a second health bar down there.
Groups without water breathing kite him back out to fight in the open.

cards.subject: The Lorgalis Manuscript
lines: Written by an elf who worshipped the Old Gods and left his book in the temple before it sank.
It calls Aku'mai the Princess of the Deep: "hers is still beyond measure. And so she is worshipped. And she is feared, and loved."
Every other source in the game says he.

cards.subject: Twilight Lord Kelris
lines: The cult leader holding the Moonshrine Sanctum is an orc, sitting in the holiest sunken room of a temple to Elune.
"Who dares disturb my meditation?" He puts you to sleep mid-fight, and kills with "Dust to dust."

cards.subject: What he fed it
lines: He personally supervised Aku'mai's growth, feeding it his own subjects to satisfy its hunger.
The cult believed the thing was a herald of the Old Gods' return.
Worth the men they walked into its mouth.

cards.subject: Argent Guard Thaelrid
cards.tag: Bleeding at the Pool of Ask'ar
lines: There is an Argent Dawn night elf inside the dungeon, badly wounded, who never reported back.
He is the one who found out what the cult was doing, and he hands out the kill order from where he lies.
His quest pays a thousand Argent Dawn reputation — decades of levels before Scholomance.

cards.subject: Killing Kelris does not open the way
lines: Four braziers on the central altar have to be lit by hand.
Each one you light summons a group of the hydra's servants out of the side doors, so you light one, fight, and light the next.
The fourth opens the road.

cards.subject: Aku'mai
lines: A hydra, ancient and Void-gifted — a favoured servant of the Old Gods, not an Old God itself and not one of the faceless.
It moved into the ruins after the moonwell turned. The cult found it there and started worshipping.
Nobody invited it.
